scope.reason: Replay reads the stored source envelope and document objects through the ingestion parser, verifying each recorded digest and length; parser output is unchanged and the parsed decision has no feature storage of its own. Read publisher page furniture and preserve document numbers and footnote targets from stored PDF text alongside printed roles, title order, bold and italic emphasis; preserve sentence continuations across spacing and indentation while retaining explicit paragraph points. Translate separately extracted reference positions after inline indices are stripped. Classify attached footnote regions before repeated furniture, using their measured line pitch and a page body-height fallback. These values have no separate feature storage. A clerk's closing mark printed after the decision is read as a publisher note rather than head matter; paragraph roles have no feature storage of their own. Read `Ŝ`, which a common Polish font encoding prints for `ż`, as `ż` in body, note and ruling text; the letter has no feature storage of its own. Drop a running header or footer set in body type and the first page's letterhead footer by their shape from stored PDF text, and read a footnote reference raised right after a number when the foot of the page opens that note; these have no separate feature storage. Read letter-spaced emphasis through the one shared reading, once a paragraph's lines are joined: a short spaced word in a text that spaces words, a row of one-letter words no sentence writes, and uneven chunks the document prints nowhere else read as the words they spell; only whitespace in block text changes and it has no feature storage of its own. Paragraph roles are recomputed from stored raw through the shared Polish role grammar on letter-spacing-collapsed text: a bench's names or a signing label with its blank under the ruling sign it, and a letter-spaced reasons heading opens the reasons; roles have no feature storage of their own. A ruling opens at its first point or its operative verb, read through letter spacing; a line that only looks marked or a list the recital announces stays in the recital, recomputed from stored raw; roles have no feature storage of their own. A document titled by its own declared type keeps that title and its reasons heading as a section, a ruling sentence that opens on its legal basis is the holding, a point whose number runs on to its verb opens the ruling, the bench opens on either wording of its composition line, and the holding ends where the bench signs; recomputed from stored raw, roles have no feature storage of their own. A printed table of contents is apparatus, a block of marks alone (a lone dash or dot) carries no body role, and in the competition authority's PDFs a short line set wholly in bold between paragraphs of the reasons is a subheading; recomputed from stored raw, roles and headings have no feature storage of their own. Roles are recomputed from stored raw: a docket line printed again inside the decision (Sygn. akt. I C 155/19, or set as a heading by the layout) is case-number, not a ruling point or a section heading. Roles have no feature storage of their own.
